demographic_skew: The only resident-level demand signal returned for Port Melbourne itself is a carer arranging a smart lock for a person with Alzheimer's who wanders and had just relocated to a Bay Street apartment (Airtasker Port Melbourne), pointing to care- and accessibility-driven apartment retrofits rather than owner-occupier convenience upgrades; no broader demographic data was returned for the suburb.
common_concerns: Whether a smart lock can be fitted at all to an apartment entry door that currently has only an interior turn knob and cannot be locked from the inside (Airtasker Port Melbourne — Bay St apartment).
Using the lock to keep a vulnerable resident safely inside while still allowing carers to get in — the wander-risk case raised in the Port Melbourne request (Airtasker Port Melbourne).
